mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals sustained economic expansion, elevating corporate earnings and investor confidence, which directly drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters with GDPC1 growth exceeding 1.5% annualized, or the rank IC between GDPC1 growth and SPX returns remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% indicates an exceptionally tight labor market, fueling wage growth and consumer spending that consistently generates positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE < 4.0, or the rank IC between UNRATE and SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% and CPIAUCSL surpasses 200, it confirms aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and CPIAUCSL > 200, or the rank IC between the joint condition and SPX returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 200), the Federal Reserve implements rate hikes that increase equity discount rates, directly causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 200, or the rank IC between CPIAUCSL and SPX returns is positive over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output, strengthening corporate profit expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with INDPRO growth exceeding 1.0% quarterly, or the rank IC between INDPRO and SPX returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signal weakening residential construction, reducing consumer spending momentum and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when HOUST < 1500, or the rank IC between HOUST and SPX returns is above 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 360000 million dollars and FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, it reflects weakening consumer demand coupled with monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with weak consumer demand
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS < 360000 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or the rank IC between the joint condition and SPX returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), the Federal Reserve typically raises rates to counter wage pressures, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE < 4.0, or the rank IC between UNRATE and SPX returns is positive over any 3-year rolling window.
